simple.prompt: When we arrived at the boarding gate, the international flight ___ already departed.
simple.explanation: Pesawat berangkat LEBIH DULU sebelum kita tiba di gerbang. Rumus Past Perfect: 'had' + past participle (V3): 'had already departed'.
hints: Peristiwa terjadi lebih awal di masa lalu sebelum peristiwa lampau lainnya.

simple.prompt: She couldn't access the database because she ___ her credentials at home.
simple.explanation: Tindakan meninggalkan kartu identitas terjadi LEBIH AWAL daripada ketidakmampuan mengakses pintu. Gunakan 'had left'.
hints: Sebab terjadi sebelum akibat di masa lampau.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Perfect dengan kata hubung 'before'.
simple.targetSentence: He had finished the report before the meeting started.
simple.explanation: Aksi pertama yang lebih awal: 'He had finished the report' + before + aksi kedua: 'the meeting started'.
hints: Aksi yang selesai lebih awal memakai 'had finished'.

simple.prompt: By the time the emergency backup generator kicked in, the servers ___ completely.
simple.explanation: Frasa 'By the time + Past Simple' berpasangan dengan Past Perfect: 'had shut down'.
hints: Frasa 'By the time' menandakan batas waktu sebelum aksi lain.

simple.targetSentence: They had not seen the revised guidelines before the audit.
simple.explanation: Subject (They) + had not + V3 (seen) + the revised guidelines before the audit.
hints: Lanjutkan dengan 'the revised guidelines before the audit'.

simple.prompt: The engineer felt confident during the test because he ___ thoroughly for three weeks.
simple.explanation: Persiapan tiga minggu terjadi sebelum ujian berlangsung di masa lalu: 'had prepared'.

simple.targetSentence: Had you met the regional director before yesterday?
simple.explanation: Had + Subject (you) + V3 (met) + Object (the regional director) + before yesterday?

simple.prompt: By the time we reached the boarding gate, the plane ___ already departed.
simple.explanation: Keberangkatan pesawat terjadi SEBELUM kami tiba di gerbang ('reached' = V2), sehingga aksi lebih awal memakai Past Perfect ('had + V3').
hints: Ada dua peristiwa lampau: mana yang terjadi lebih dulu?

simple.prompt: She wasn't hungry at noon because she ___ just eaten a large breakfast.
simple.explanation: Makan pagi terjadi sebelum tengah hari di masa lalu ('wasn't hungry'), jadi gunakan Past Perfect ('had just eaten').
hints: Lebih lampau dari Past Simple memakai 'had'.

simple.prompt: Before Marco moved to Tokyo in 2021, he ___ never lived abroad.
simple.explanation: Pengalaman sebelum satu titik waktu di masa lalu ('Before Marco moved...') memakai Past Perfect ('had never lived').
hints: Titik batasnya adalah tahun 2021 di masa lalu.
Sebelum titik lampau memakai 'had never + V3'.

simple.prompt: Had all the delegates ___ their feedback forms before the workshop closed?
simple.explanation: Dalam kalimat tanya Past Perfect ('Had + Subject + V3...?'), verb wajib berbentuk Past Participle (V3): 'submitted'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di kantor tentang pengiriman yang terlewat.
dialogue: Did you manage to stop the courier before he left the lobby?
Unfortunately not — he ___ already driven away when I got downstairs.
simple.explanation: Kurir pergi lebih dulu sebelum staf turun ('got downstairs'), maka gunakan 'had'.
hints: Urutan kejadiannya: kurir berangkat → staf turun.

simple.prompt: They ___ checked the weather forecast, so they were caught completely off guard by the storm.
simple.explanation: Mereka lupa/belum mengecek prakiraan cuaca sebelum badai datang di masa lalu ('were caught'), memakai negatif Past Perfect 'hadn't'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan bentuk kata kerja setelah 'had' pada kalimat berikut.
simple.draft: After the interns had took inventory, they locked the storage cabinet.
options: After the interns had taken inventory, they locked the storage cabinet.
After the interns have taken inventory, they locked the storage cabinet.
After the interns had tooked inventory, they locked the storage cabinet.
simple.explanation: V3 dari 'take' adalah 'taken', bukan V2 'took'. Pastikan selalu memakai V3 setelah 'had'.

simple.prompt: Had Maya seen that safety report before the meeting? — No, she ___.
simple.explanation: Jawaban singkat negatif dari pertanyaan 'Had Maya...?' harus konsisten menggunakan 'hadn't'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai frasa 'By the time' dengan Past Perfect.
simple.targetSentence: By the time the plumber arrived, the basement floor had already flooded.
simple.explanation: Aksi banjir terjadi lebih dulu ('had already flooded') sebelum tukang ledeng datang ('arrived').
hints: Awali dengan 'By the time the plumber arrived,'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pengalaman sebelum titik lampau memakai 'until yesterday'.
simple.targetSentence: I had never tasted fresh durian until I visited Penang last summer.
simple.explanation: Sampai titik lampau ('visited Penang'), pengalaman itu belum pernah terjadi ('had never tasted').
hints: Mulai dengan 'I had never tasted fresh durian'.
Sambungkan 'until I visited Penang last summer'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog klarifikasi urutan kejadian masa lalu.
dialogue: Why was the press release delayed?
Because legal ___ the draft before we submitted it to the media.
intermediate.explanation: Penyebab sebelum pengiriman adalah persetujuan legal yang belum keluar: 'had not approved'.
hints: Gunakan Past Perfect negatif 'had not approved'.

intermediate.prompt: Notice the difference: 'When the meeting started, the manager arrived' (Sequence: after) vs 'When the meeting started, the manager ___' (Already there: earlier).
intermediate.explanation: Jika manajer sudah ada di ruangan SEBELUM rapat dimulai, gunakan Past Perfect: 'had already arrived'. Jika manajer baru tiba SETELAH rapat mulai, gunakan Past Simple 'arrived'.
hints: Manajer sudah ada di sana lebih awal sebelum rapat dimulai.

intermediate.prompt: By 2020, the software enterprise ___ over one hundred million registered users worldwide.
intermediate.explanation: Frasa 'By + titik waktu lampau' (By 2020) adalah penanda baku tuntasnya pencapaian sebelum waktu tersebut, sehingga memakai Past Perfect: 'had acquired'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan konjungsi urutan 'as soon as' dan Past Perfect.
intermediate.targetSentence: As soon as he had signed the contract he left the office.
intermediate.explanation: As soon as + Past Perfect (he had signed the contract) + Past Simple (he left the office).
hints: Mulai dengan 'As soon as he had signed the contract'.

intermediate.prompt: I didn't recognize my childhood classmate because he ___ so significantly.
intermediate.explanation: Perubahan fisik terjadi bertahap selama bertahun-tahun SEBELUM momen perjumpaan di masa lalu: 'had changed'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pengalaman pertama di masa lampau.
intermediate.targetSentence: It was the first time she had flown on a commercial aircraft.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam konteks narasi lampau: 'It was the first time + Past Perfect (she had flown)'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'It was the first time'.
Gunakan Past Perfect: 'she had flown on a commercial aircraft'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih jawaban singkat Past Perfect yang tepat.
dialogue: Had the client submitted the tax compliance form prior to the deadline?
intermediate.explanation: Jawaban singkat positif untuk pertanyaan 'Had they...?' adalah 'Yes, they had.'

intermediate.prompt: It was the very first time our startup ___ a contract with an overseas university.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam bentuk lampau ('It WAS the first time...'), konstruksi pengikutnya bergeser mundur menjadi Past Perfect ('had signed').
hints: Perhatikan to be lampau 'It was the very first time...'.
Bentuk Present 'It is...' pakai Present Perfect; 'It was...' pakai Past Perfect.

intermediate.prompt: He ___ the whole compliance manual twice before the auditors arrived for inspection.
intermediate.explanation: Pekerjaan membaca selesai tuntas sebelum para auditor datang ('arrived'): 'had read' (V3 'read' dieja sama, dibaca /red/).

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan kantor yang membedakan Past Simple vs Past Perfect.
dialogue: Why did Maya apologize so earnestly during the call?
She realized she ___ the wrong spreadsheet attachment five minutes earlier.
intermediate.explanation: Pada saat Maya sadar ('realized' = V2), tindakan mengirim lampiran salah itu sudah terjadi lebih dulu ('five minutes earlier'), sehingga memakai Past Perfect ('had sent').
hints: Urutan kejadian: mengirim file salah → baru sadar.
Aksi lebih awal dalam kilas balik memakai 'had sent'.

intermediate.prompt: Once the technician ___ calibrated every sensor, the assembly line resumed full speed.
intermediate.explanation: Konjungsi 'Once' (segera setelah selesai) dalam konteks lampau ('resumed') memakai Past Perfect ('had calibrated') untuk aksi prasyarat.
hints: Kalibrasi selesai tuntas sebelum jalur perakitan berjalan lagi.

intermediate.prompt: We ___ saved enough emergency funds, so the sudden rent hike didn't disrupt operations.
intermediate.explanation: Adverb seperti 'fortunately' atau 'already' ditempatkan di antara 'had' dan V3: 'had fortunately saved'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan pemakaian Past Perfect yang berlebihan (overuse) untuk kejadian yang berurutan alami berikut.
intermediate.draft: When the alarm went off at six, Riko had brushed his teeth, had dressed quickly, and had caught the early bus.
options: When the alarm went off at six, Riko brushed his teeth, dressed quickly, and caught the early bus.
When the alarm had gone off at six, Riko brushed his teeth, dressed quickly, and had caught the early bus.
When the alarm went off at six, Riko had brushed his teeth, dressed quickly, and caught the early bus.
intermediate.explanation: Jika serangkaian peristiwa diceritakan secara kronologis urut dari awal sampai akhir (bangun → sikat gigi → berpakaian → naik bus), gunakan Past Simple sederhana agar tidak kaku dan berlebihan.
hints: Semua kejadian sudah diceritakan urut dari awal sampai akhir.
Rangkaian aksi berurutan kronologis memakai Past Simple biasa.

intermediate.prompt: She wished she ___ accepted the internship offer in Kyoto when it was still open.
intermediate.explanation: Menyesali keputusan di masa lalu dengan pola 'wish' memakai Past Perfect ('wished she had accepted').
hints: Penyesalan tentang masa lampau memakai 'wish + S + had + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: If the warehouse crew ___ inspected the pallet seal earlier, the moisture damage wouldn't have happened.
intermediate.explanation: Third conditional (pengandaian masa lalu yang tidak terjadi) memakai Past Perfect di dalam if-clause ('If ... had inspected').

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat penyesalan masa lampau dengan 'wish' dan Past Perfect.
intermediate.targetSentence: The founder wished she had patented the packaging design earlier.
intermediate.explanation: 'Wish + S + had + V3' menyatakan penyesalan atas hal yang tidak dilakukan di masa lalu.
hints: Awali dengan 'The founder wished she had'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat rencana lampau yang gagal terlaksana dengan 'had hoped'.
intermediate.targetSentence: We had hoped to launch the beta version before Friday.
intermediate.explanation: 'Had hoped to + V1' menunjukkan rencana/harapan di masa lalu yang akhirnya tidak terwujud.
hints: Mulai dengan 'We had hoped to launch'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan overusing Past Perfect ketika urutan kejadian sudah sepenuhnya jelas melalui 'before' atau 'after'.
complex.draft: After the conference had concluded, the delegates had departed for the airport.
options: After the conference concluded, the delegates departed for the airport.
After the conference has concluded, the delegates had departed for the airport.
After the conference had been concluding, the delegates were departing for the airport.
complex.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris baku modern, jika kata hubung 'before' atau 'after' sudah secara gamblang memperjelas urutan kronologis, tidak perlu menumpuk Past Perfect pada kedua klausa. Gunakan Past Simple yang elegan: 'After the conference concluded, the delegates departed...'.
hints: Hindari menumpuk Past Perfect ganda di kedua klausa.
Gunakan Past Simple pada kedua aksi yang dihubungkan 'after'.

complex.prompt: Pola inversi dramatis sastra dengan 'Hardly ... when': 'Hardly ___ the auditorium when the keynote address commenced.'
complex.explanation: Pola inversi naratif: 'Hardly + had + Subject + V3... when + Past Simple' (Baru saja... ketika...).

complex.prompt: Pola inversi 'No sooner ... than': 'No sooner ___ the security patch than another vulnerability was detected.'
complex.explanation: Pola inversi korelatif: 'No sooner + had + Subject + V3... THAN + Past Simple' (Tidak lama setelah... langsung...).
hints: Memerlukan inversi Past Perfect: 'No sooner had the engineers deployed'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat penyesalan hipotetis masa lampau (Third Conditional).
complex.targetSentence: If you had informed me earlier I would have assisted you.
complex.explanation: Third conditional: If + Past Perfect (had informed me earlier) + would have + V3 (assisted you).
hints: Klausa if: 'If you had informed me earlier'.
Klausa hasil: 'I would have assisted you'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan pengandaian masa lampau dengan 'wish'.
complex.draft: I wish I studied software engineering instead of economics when I was at university.
options: I wish I had studied software engineering instead of economics when I was at university.
I wish I have studied software engineering instead of economics when I was at university.
I wish I would study software engineering instead of economics when I was at university.
complex.explanation: Untuk menyatakan penyesalan atas peristiwa masa lalu yang sudah tidak bisa diubah (past regret), setelah 'wish' WAJIB menggunakan Past Perfect: 'I wish I had studied...'.
hints: Penyesalan terhadap masa lalu yang sudah lewat.
Gunakan 'wish + Past Perfect': 'wish I had studied'.

complex.prompt: We had hoped that the regulatory body ___ the merger, but they blocked it on antitrust grounds.
complex.explanation: Harapan masa lalu yang tidak terwujud (unfulfilled past hope: 'We had hoped that...') diikuti oleh 'would + base verb'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog analisis kegagalan sistem dengan Third Conditional.
dialogue: Why did the transaction crash the payment gateway?
If we ___ the stress test yesterday, this wouldn't have occurred.
complex.explanation: Kondisi pengandaian masa lalu yang tidak terjadi (Third Conditional): 'If we had executed...'.

complex.prompt: Scarcely had the committee adjourned ___ new evidence surfaced.
complex.explanation: Berbeda dengan 'No sooner ... than', konstruksi inversi Past Perfect dengan 'Scarcely' atau 'Hardly' WAJIB berpasangan dengan 'when' (bukan 'than').

complex.prompt: No sooner had the new tariff taken effect ___ domestic shipping firms adjusted their rates.
complex.explanation: 'No sooner + had + S + V3' selalu berpasangan dengan 'than' untuk dua kejadian lampau yang nyaris seketika berurutan.
hints: Lihat kata pembanding 'No sooner' di awal kalimat.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan perpaduan tense pada kalimat rencana masa lalu yang batal berikut.
complex.draft: The consortium was intending to acquire three ferries, or rather had been plan to buy them before fuel prices doubled.
options: The consortium had intended to acquire three ferries before fuel prices doubled.
The consortium has intended to acquire three ferries before fuel prices doubled.
The consortium had intend to acquire three ferries before fuel prices doubled.
complex.explanation: Untuk menyatakan niat/rencana masa lalu yang kandas sebelum kejadian lampau lain ('before fuel prices doubled'), gunakan Past Perfect bentuk baku 'had intended to' atau 'had planned to' (V3 setelah 'had').
hints: Cari bentuk Past Perfect murni setelah 'had' (V3).
'Had intended to' sangat ringkas untuk rencana masa lalu yang urung.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi diskusi penyuntingan gaya bahasa mengenai kapan Past Perfect BISA dihilangkan.
dialogue: In 'After she had reviewed the appendix, she signed off', do we strictly need 'had'?
Because 'after' already makes the sequence crystal clear, ___ is also completely grammatical and often cleaner.
options: After she has reviewed the appendix
Before she had been reviewing the appendix
complex.explanation: Ketika kata sambung waktu ('before' atau 'after') sudah membuat urutan waktu 100% jelas dan tidak ambigu, Past Simple sering dipilih menggantikan Past Perfect demi keringkasan gaya tulis.
hints: Past Simple sering menggantikan Past Perfect setelah 'after/before'.

complex.prompt: Had the board ___ the quarterly reserves earlier, the liquidity crunch could have been avoided.
complex.explanation: Inversi Conditional Tipe 3 menghilangkan 'If' dan menukar 'Had' ke depan subjek: 'Had the board + V3 (diversified)...'.
hints: Bentuk ini adalah inversi Third Conditional tanpa 'If'.

complex.prompt: Little did analysts know that a minor software patch ___ disabled the backup router three days prior.
complex.explanation: Kejadian 'three days prior' sebelum momen penemuan lampau ('did analysts know') wajib memakai Past Perfect ('had silently disabled').
hints: 'Three days prior' mendahului kejadian lampau 'did analysts know'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum posisi auxiliary dalam inversi Past Perfect negatif 'Hardly' berikut.
complex.draft: Hardly the new director had introduced himself when the fire drill interrupted the assembly.
options: Hardly had the new director introduced himself when the fire drill interrupted the assembly.
Hardly did the new director had introduced himself when the fire drill interrupted the assembly.
Hardly had introduced the new director himself when the fire drill interrupted the assembly.
complex.explanation: Ketika 'Hardly' mengawali kalimat, auxiliary 'had' wajib dipindah tepat setelah 'Hardly' sebelum subjek: 'Hardly had + S + V3... when...'.
hints: 'Hardly' di awal kalimat memicu inversi auxiliary + subjek.

complex.prompt: By 2015, the historic canal ___ silted up so severely that cargo barges could no longer pass.
complex.explanation: Kondisi yang sudah selesai/terjadi sebelum batas tahun lampau ('By 2015') menggunakan Past Perfect ('had silted up').
hints: 'By + tahun lampau' hampir selalu memicu Past Perfect.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi formal dengan 'No sooner ... than'.
complex.targetSentence: No sooner had the server rebooted than traffic returned to normal.
complex.explanation: 'No sooner had + S + V3' diikuti 'than' + Past Simple.
hints: Mulai dengan 'No sooner had the server rebooted'.
Sambungkan dengan 'than traffic returned to normal'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pengandaian inversi Tipe 3 (tanpa kata 'If').
complex.targetSentence: Had we consulted the local engineers sooner, the delay would have been minor.
complex.explanation: 'Had + Subject + V3' menggantikan klausa 'If we had consulted...'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Had we consulted the local engineers sooner,'.
Akhiri dengan klausa hasil 'would have been minor'.
